sections.heading: Handyman Services in Fordingbridge, SP6: Full Coverage
sections.body: FixWell Services provides comprehensive handyman and home repair cover across Fordingbridge and the SP6 postcode. Our Fordingbridge customers book us for a wide range of work: fence and gate repairs, garden maintenance, paving slab replacement, general home repairs, internal painting and decorating, minor plumbing fixes, carpentry, shelf installation, and emergency callouts. Fordingbridge's position on the northern edge of the New Forest means many properties have larger plots with fencing, outbuildings, and outdoor areas that need regular attention. We also serve the growing number of holiday lets and second homes in the area, providing property preparation and maintenance between guest stays. All work is fully insured and quoted clearly before we start.

sections.heading: Fordingbridge Properties: Period Cottages, Post-War Estates and Rural Fringe
sections.body: Fordingbridge sits on the River Avon at the meeting point of Wiltshire and Hampshire, and its housing reflects centuries of building rather than a single development era. The historic town centre, concentrated around the medieval bridge, the High Street, and Provost Street, contains period cottages, Victorian terraces, and older townhouses, many of them in a conservation area. Common maintenance needs in these older homes include damp-related plaster repairs, repainting timber windows and doors, carpentry repairs to period joinery, and fixing shelves in solid-wall construction. Further from the centre, residential streets to the north and east of Fordingbridge contain 1970s and 1980s semi-detached and detached housing, a completely different maintenance profile but equally well served by FixWell. Rural properties and smallholdings beyond the town boundary add garden maintenance, fence work, and outdoor repairs to the job mix.

sections.heading: How FixWell Operates in Fordingbridge

sections.heading: Cost of Handyman Services in Fordingbridge
sections.body: Our standard rate of £20 to £40 per hour applies to all work in Fordingbridge. There is no travel surcharge for SP6 callouts: the A338 route from Salisbury is direct and the distance is well within our standard service zone. For holiday-let owners needing property prepared between bookings, we can work to your changeover schedule.
